description: Every standing operator decision that governs these rails — what was decided, the operator's words, and the machine-checkable enforcement (lane state, kill switches, env vars, CI tests) that makes it real. Ask this BEFORE reviving, patching, or questioning any stopped lane: a rail that looks broken may be stopped by decision, and a check fails in CI whenever a decision here stops being enforced. Free, keyless, read-only, no chain reads.

id.description: Optional: return just this decision id, e.g. no-sell-walls.

title: The operator decision ledger — standing law, with its enforcement
